end.summary:
Practised choosing exact or approximate values in real-life situations.
Rounded large numbers to the nearest lakh and considered headline-style approximations.
Worked with place value in 45,872,000 and 3,26,400.
Place-value and rounding mix-ups remained in the final responses; teach-back was not passed.
end.parentNote: Asha practised when to use exact numbers, such as ticket counts, and when rounded numbers are suitable, such as headlines. They also practised identifying digits and rounding to the nearest lakh. A mix-up between the ten-thousands digit and the lakh place remained in the last example. At home, ask them to round a few numbers such as population or video-view counts and explain which digit they checked.
